description: The International Transport Forum publishes its transport statistics as datasets in the OECD Data Explorer. They include transport infrastructure investment, maintenance spending and capital value for road, rail, inland waterways, maritime ports and airports, collected through the Investment Spending in Transport Infrastructure survey and published in euros at current and constant 2015 prices each 31 March from 1995; annual trends in the transport sector from 1970 (inland freight and passenger transport, container transport by rail and sea, length of rail lines, roads and navigable waterways, road fatalities, injuries and injury crashes), published each 31 October; short-term quarterly indicators; and more than 90 transport performance indicators on infrastructure, equipment, activity, safety, traffic, economy and environment. Data come from ministries of transport, national statistical offices and other official sources in member countries. Coverage is the ITF member countries, across several continents. The data are free to query and download from the OECD Data Explorer and its SDMX API; no licence was readable on the day. Caveats: definitions vary by country and recent years may be missing. It supports international comparison of infrastructure spending, network growth and safety for capacity planning. It complements the Eurostat and Destatis transport statistics and is related to the DfT road traffic counts.
